physical: Channel capacity — The greatest rate at which information can be sent reliably through a noisy channel is the bandwidth times the log of one plus the signal-to-noise ratio. C = B × log(1 + S ÷ N). Form: definition.
reflected_sentence: The definition keeps its shape: the most that can pass reliably is an extent multiplied by how far the wanted stands above the unwanted — but none of these have partners, so the reading can only be said in plain words.
rule_reason: definition with no listed cost and no resistance-carrying quantity (capacity, bandwidth, power and noise power are all fixed as non-resistance); zero costs is an even count, so the shape keeps
interpretation: Nothing crosses. The shape keeps in silence.
closing: The rule decided on its own: a definition containing no cost and no resistance-carrier keeps its shape by the even-count clause. The only discretion was refusing to invent partners for capacity and bandwidth, which the frozen vocabulary withholds; that does not touch the keeps call.
